name: Vercel Connect
summary: Vercel Connect lets apps and agents deployed on Vercel get short-lived, scoped tokens for services like Slack, GitHub, Microsoft, Linear and Snowflake at the moment they need them, so no provider secret sits in environment variables. Connectors are set up once per team and linked to projects; every token request is logged. Generally available since August 2026.
facts: Slack, GitHub, Microsoft, Teams, Linear, Snowflake, Salesforce, custom OAuth, API key
Observability tab logs token requests and revocations
goodFor: Removing long-lived API keys from env vars
Acting on behalf of users with refreshable tokens
watchOut: Best fit inside the Vercel platform (OIDC auth)
Smaller catalog than tool aggregators; you write the API calls
